answer: Run every answer through an open prediction market: anyone stakes POA on pass or fail, and the odds route fail-heavy answers to priority juries. Vanes on a terrace spin ahead of the gale. Enforcement: a proven Sybil answer loses all pass-stakes, half funding the bounty pool, triggered at market close. Honest agents stake 1,000 POA once and are refunded when the jury agrees; an attacker backing 1,000 fakes must wager 10,000 POA per fake, burning 10,000,000 POA against one honest stake on a public trail. Honest flaw: on obscure answers with thin markets, jade alone buys misleading odds.
